# 📊 NBFC Daily Watch — Wednesday, October 28, 2026

*Wednesday, Oct 28, 2026 edition. Indian prices are Tuesday's (27 Oct) close. Gold spot and MCX gold are this morning's early-Asia prints, and Brent is Tuesday's settlement. Muthoot Fincorp Ltd is a separate company from Muthoot Finance Ltd; Muthoot Finance appears here as a listed lender.*

## 🔴 URGENT / High Impact

**1. Gold sits about 20% below its January record, and analysts have started putting peer LTVs side by side. The SGB redemption price RBI set for today says the same thing.**
- BusinessToday (27 Oct) says gold is roughly **20% below its record of ₹1,76,306/10g** set on 29 Jan, and it opened Tuesday at **₹1,40,664**. Equirus's Shreepal Doshi lists LTVs of **Muthoot Finance 64%** (Q1), **Manappuram 65.6%**, **Fedbank 68%** (Q2), **IIFL 70%** (Q2) and **Capri Global 73.35%** (Q1), calling Capri's position "less comfortable". Gold-loan yields have slipped to **75–79 bps a month**, down from 100–105 bps. ([BusinessToday](https://www.businesstoday.in/latest/corporate/story/gold-prices-correct-jewellers-may-gain-but-will-gold-loan-growth-and-lender-margins-take-a-hit-564084-2026-10-27))
- The RBI fixed the premature redemption price of **SGB 2020-21 Series I**, due today, at **₹14,159 per gram**. That is the simple average of IBJA 999 closing prices on 23, 26 and 27 Oct. ([RBI press release](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63872))
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** Muthoot Fincorp is not on the Equirus list, so its portfolio LTV is not part of this comparison. As an illustration of the arithmetic, a loan written at 75% LTV at the January peak would now be at about **94%** of current gold value (75 ÷ 0.80).

**2. NBFCs are pulling back from drought-hit rural districts. The south is the worst-hit region.**
- **Shriram, M&M Finance and Bajaj Finance** are curbing fresh loans in districts hit by the weak monsoon. The season ended **13% below normal**, the weakest since 2015. Rainfall was **−24% in the southern peninsula** and **−32% in Karnataka**. Shriram's Parag Sharma said it may revise LTV norms. M&M Finance is watching 3 states and 282 drought-prone districts. Bajaj is tracking 720 districts and has cut MFI originations in some of them. ([ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/nbfcs-curb-fresh-loans-in-rural-markets-as-weak-monsoon-raises-repayment-risks/articleshow/135222291.cms))
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** Muthoot Fincorp is Kerala-based with a large southern network, and its subsidiary Muthoot Microfin also lends in the south, the region with the largest rainfall deficit. If large lenders pull back from drought districts, lenders that stay may see both more demand and more risk.

**3. Tata Capital's PAT jumped 51%, and it is passing the repo hike through: floating rates go up 20–25 bps from 1 Nov.**
- Q2 FY27 PAT was **₹1,660 cr** (₹1,097 cr a year ago). AUM is **₹3.08 lakh cr (+26%)** and NII **₹3,696 cr (+23%)**. Asset quality: GS3 **1.9%**, NS3 0.8%, PCR 58.6%. Capital: CRAR 17.3%, Tier 1 14.7%. ([ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/earnings/tata-capital-q2-net-profit-rises-51-on-higher-income/articleshow/135239343.cms), [BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/tata-capitals-consolidated-q2-net-profit-jumps-51-to-1660-cr/article71632266.ece))
- Management said floating-rate loans will be repriced **20–25 bps higher from 1 Nov** after the RBI's rate hike. Revolving and flexi loans, the products the RBI's August draft would bar, make up **3–4% of AUM**. ([ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/earnings/tata-capital-q2-net-profit-rises-51-on-higher-income/articleshow/135239343.cms))
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** Large lenders are repricing their books upward. Muthoot Fincorp's gold loans are largely short-tenor, so pricing on new loans and renewals is the main lever for passing on higher funding costs.


## 🏢 Muthoot Fincorp in the market

- **Tranche I public NCD issue (open 23 Oct – 5 Nov 2026).** Bids stood at 1.25 times the ₹200 cr base issue at 17:00 on 27 Oct, up from 0.99× on Monday: retail 1.02×, HNI 1.74×, non-institutional 0.90×, institutional 0.00×. The issue is ₹200 cr base plus ₹300 cr green shoe, allotted first come, first served, and closes Thu 5 Nov. ([Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/))
- **Subsidiary.** Muthoot Microfin, Muthoot Fincorp's listed microfinance subsidiary, holds its Q2 board meeting on 5 Nov. ([StockFin](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/MUTHOOTMF/2026-10-23/board-meeting))

## 📈 Market & Stock Summary

- **Tuesday 27 Oct close:** Sensex **73,598.67 (−8.08, −0.01%)**, Nifty **22,749.75 (−3.45, −0.02%)**. Infosys cut its FY27 outlook and IT fell 1.4%, while the Smallcap 100 rose 2.69%. ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-market-ends-flat-as-infosys-drags-it-stocks-defence-shares-rally/article71631323.ece), [Business Standard/PTI](https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/sensex-nifty-close-largely-unchanged-amid-selling-in-bank-it-stocks-elevated-crude-oil-prices-126102701164_1.html))
- **Financials lagged again:**
  - Nifty Financial Services **24,303.75 (−0.62%)** and Bank Nifty 53,974.90 (−0.72%).
  - Fin Services ex-Bank was flat (+0.05%), and Nifty Housing Finance rose **+0.63%**.
  - ([NSE index closes](https://archives.nseindia.com/content/indices/ind_close_all_27102026.csv))
- **NBFC peers (NSE close):**
  - Manappuram Finance **₹286.45 (−0.37%)**
  - Muthoot Finance **₹2,407.50 (+0.49%)**
  - IIFL Finance **₹527.55 (−0.31%)**
  - Shriram Finance **₹823.60 (−0.17%)**
  - Bajaj Finance **₹912.00 (−0.73%)**
  - ([exa.ai NSE closes](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/MANAPPURAM?exchange=XNSE&date=2026-10-27&view=daily))
- **Flows (27 Oct, provisional):** FII **+₹4,240.39 cr**, DII **−₹1,250.03 cr**. This was the FIIs' biggest net purchase of October. ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/fiis-buy-rs4240-crore-in-indian-stocks-as-diis-turn-net-sellers-20020667.htm))
- **Tax review:** the Centre is consulting investors and experts on LTCG and STT as FPI outflows continue. No decision has been taken. ([ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/govt-seeks-investor-and-expert-views-on-ltcg-and-stt-as-it-reviews-capital-market-levies-amid-fpi-exodus/articleshow/135218874.cms))
- **Rupee:** closed at **95.12/$ (+3 paise)**, ending a three-day fall. ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/forex/rupee-closes-marginally-up-3-paise-at-9512-against-us-dollar-amid-elevated-crude-oil-prices/article71630954.ece))
- **Oil and gold:**
  - Brent settled at **$113.88 (−$1.93)** as Mideast talks eased supply fears, even after a Houthi strike on Ras Tanura. UBS sees around $110 through year-end. ([The Star/Reuters](https://www.thestar.com.my/business/2026/10/28/oil-slides-as-mideast-talks-ease-supply-fears))
  - Spot gold was **$4,060.73/oz** at 05:00 IST, holding Tuesday's 1.1% gain ahead of tonight's Fed decision, where a hold is widely expected. ([Business Times/Bloomberg](https://www.businesstimes.com.sg/companies-markets/energy-commodities/gold-holds-above-us4000-traders-look-us-fed-rate-decision))

## 🏛️ RBI & Regulatory — Headlines Only

- **RBI, 27 Oct: two UAPA Section 51A circulars addressed to NBFCs among others.**
  - RBI/2026-27/301 removes 3 entries from the UNSC 1267/1989 ISIL & Al-Qaida sanctions list. ([RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=13747&Mode=0))
  - RBI/2026-27/302 amends 3 entries. ([RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=13748&Mode=0))
- **RBI, 26 Oct:** RBI/2026-27/300 on lead-bank responsibility for the re-organised Delhi districts. This is for banks only. ([RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=13746&Mode=0))
- **SEBI, 27 Oct:** debenture trustees get six more months, up to **27 Apr 2027**, to move non-SEBI activities into separate business units. ([SEBI](https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/oct-2026/extension-of-timeline-for-compliance-with-terms-and-conditions-by-debenture-trustees-dts-for-carrying-out-activities-outside-the-purview-of-sebi_105454.html))
- **RBI drafts:** nothing new after 11 Sep. The August draft barring NBFCs from revolving credit is still pending. **IBBI:** nothing since 24 Sep. ([Drafts](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/DraftNotificationsGuildelines.aspx), [IBBI](https://ibbi.gov.in/en/legal-framework/circulars))
- More detail on the Rules page.

## 💰 Financial Results & Performance

- **Tata Capital, Q2 FY27:** see #3.
  - Loan-loss provisions fell 16.6% to **₹645 cr**.
  - The company plans a capital raise in H2 FY28.
  - ([ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/earnings/tata-capital-q2-net-profit-rises-51-on-higher-income/articleshow/135239343.cms))
- **TVS Credit, Q2:** PAT **₹243 cr (+19%)**, AUM **₹33,818 cr (+22%)**, disbursements +31%. ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/tvs-credit-reports-19-growth-in-q2-pat-at-243-crore/article71632336.ece))
- **PTC India Financial, Q2:**
  - PAT was **₹44 cr (+9.5%)**, but PBT was just ₹17.02 cr (₹117.63 cr a year ago), after a ₹51.17 cr impairment charge.
  - It missed the 75% infrastructure-asset threshold for NBFC-IFC status by the RBI's extended 30 Sep deadline and met it later.
  - It made a technical write-off of ₹187.91 cr.
  - ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/ptc-india-financial-services-q2-results-share-price-net-profit-rises-rs44-crore-nii-up-rbi-finance-expposure-20020528.htm))
- **Home First Finance, Q2:** see the deep dive below.
- **Results calendar:**
  - Today, **28 Oct**: **Cholamandalam** and **PNB Housing**.
  - **30 Oct**: LIC Housing Finance.
  - **5 Nov**: **Muthoot Microfin**, Muthoot Fincorp's subsidiary.
  - ([StockWatch – Chola](https://www.stockwatch.live/in/news/cholamandalam-investment-trading-window-closed-for-q2-results-31e0d9f9-df8c-475f-a63b-f38a4cb6db50), [AlphaStreet – PNB Housing](https://alphastreet.com/india/pnb-housing-finance-ltd-pnbhousing-earnings-call-invite-for-the-2nd-quarter-and-half-year-ended-september-30-2026/), [StockFin – Muthoot Microfin](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/MUTHOOTMF/2026-10-23/board-meeting))

## ⚠️ Credit Rating Actions

- No significant developments today.
- **Muthoot Fincorp ratings unchanged:**
  - CRISIL AA/Stable and Brickwork AA+/Stable on Tranche I ([Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/)).
  - CARE AA/Stable from 5 Oct ([CARE PR](https://www.careratings.com/upload/CompanyFiles/PR/202610121058_Muthoot_Fincorp_Limited.pdf)).

## 🔄 Deals & M&A

- No significant developments today.

## 💻 Digital & Fintech

- **Revolving credit:** the RBI's August draft would restrict NBFCs to term loans. The RBI has described the restriction as a clarification of existing rules rather than a new rule. Bajaj Finance is introducing new term-loan variants from 1 Nov. ([Mint](https://www.livemint.com/industry/banking/rbi-says-nbfc-ban-on-revolving-credit-is-a-clarification-not-a-new-rule-11791378140568.html), [Moneycontrol](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/banks/bajaj-finance-to-introduce-new-term-loan-variants-after-rbi-draft-proposal-on-revolving-credit-ban-14055712.html))
  - **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** gold-loan products that work like a drawable limit (an overdraft-style top-up or credit line) would be affected if the final directions restrict NBFCs to term loans.

## 📉 NPA & Asset Quality

- **Rural stress:** see #2. Large lenders are now cutting fresh exposure ahead of the stress rather than waiting for it to show up in DPD. ([ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/nbfcs-curb-fresh-loans-in-rural-markets-as-weak-monsoon-raises-repayment-risks/articleshow/135222291.cms))
- **Gold loans:** Piramal's estimate is back in circulation: **15–23%** of FY26 gold-loan disbursements went to borrowers who were 90+ DPD on another loan. ([BusinessToday](https://www.businesstoday.in/latest/corporate/story/gold-prices-correct-jewellers-may-gain-but-will-gold-loan-growth-and-lender-margins-take-a-hit-564084-2026-10-27))
- **Tata Capital:** GS3 was **1.9%** and provisions fell 16.6%. The stress is not showing up across the board. ([ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/earnings/tata-capital-q2-net-profit-rises-51-on-higher-income/articleshow/135239343.cms))

## 👤 Personnel & Leadership

- **Home First Finance:** **Rinkoo Somani** is CFO, effective 27 Oct. She previously worked at HDFC, HDFC Bank, IDFC and IDFC FIRST Bank, and was most recently group CFO at the Dani family office. ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/home-first-finance-q2-results-share-price-net-profit-rises-29-pc-nii-up-asset-quality-cfo-20020584.htm))

## 🏘️ Sector Deep Dive — Wednesday: Housing finance

### Affordable HFCs are still growing fast. The repo hike is the test.

**1. Home First is the first affordable HFC to report Q2, and its numbers held up** ([investor presentation](https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachLive/c80dce47-aa17-4ab5-bccf-0ef6fb28f70d.pdf), [CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/home-first-finance-q2-results-share-price-net-profit-rises-29-pc-nii-up-asset-quality-cfo-20020584.htm)):

| Metric | Q2 FY27 |
|---|---|
| AUM | ₹18,010 cr (+27.0% YoY) |
| Disbursements | ₹1,705 cr (a record quarter) |
| PAT | ₹170.2 cr (+29.1% YoY, +6.5% QoQ) |
| RoA / RoE | 4.2% / 14.9% |
| 1+ DPD / 30+ DPD | 4.7% / 3.2% |
| GNPA / NNPA / Stage 3 PCR | 1.74% / 1.34% / 23.6% |
| Credit cost | 40 bps |
| Cost of borrowing / marginal COB | 7.8% / 7.5% |
| Origination yield (ex co-lending) | 13.0% |

**2. Margins are where the pressure shows.** Spreads excluding co-lending narrowed **10 bps** in the quarter. Home First's last prime-lending-rate (PLR) move was a **10 bp cut in January 2026**, and there has been no hike since the RBI raised rates. Its marginal cost of borrowing (7.5%) is still below its book cost (7.8%), which gives it some room for now. Stage 3 PCR of 23.6% is thin and relies on property collateral. ([investor presentation](https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachLive/c80dce47-aa17-4ab5-bccf-0ef6fb28f70d.pdf))

**3. The sector backdrop:**
- The RBI's NBFC review in its October Bulletin puts housing credit growth at **12.1%** (Aug 2026). That compares with **22%** for retail overall and **69.1%** for gold-jewellery loans. ([ETBFSI](https://bfsi.economictimes.indiatimes.com/articles/nbfcs-shift-towards-secured-retail-credit-as-microfinance-loans-decline/135153797))
- The Nifty Housing Finance index rose **+0.63%** on a day when financials fell. ([NSE](https://archives.nseindia.com/content/indices/ind_close_all_27102026.csv))
- **PNB Housing** reports tonight and **LIC Housing** on 30 Oct. Watch both for repricing: whether they pass on the rate hike or absorb it.

> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** Housing is not a core Muthoot Fincorp product. Home First's spread narrowed by 10 bps without a rate shock to its own book, while gold-loan yields across the sector have slipped to 75–79 bps a month (see #1).

reports.title: What changed in the rules
reports.content:
# 📋 NBFC Regulatory Daily Report
**Date:** Wednesday, 28 October 2026 (IST)

---

## 🔔 New Regulatory Updates Today

Two RBI circulars dated **27 Oct** are addressed to NBFCs. Both are routine sanctions-list updates that require regulated entities to update their sanctions screening. SEBI issued one debt-market circular, and it is aimed at debenture trustees, not issuers. Nothing new from RBI drafts or IBBI.

### 1. [CIRCULAR] UAPA s51A: UNSC 1267/1989 ISIL & Al-Qaida list, **removal of 3 entries**
- **Reference:** `RBI/2026-27/301` · `DoR.AML.REC.253/14.06.001/2026-27` · **27 Oct 2026**
- **Addressed to:** banks of all types, **Non-Banking Financial Companies**, ARCs and AIFIs.
- **What it says:** MEA has relayed UNSC press release **SC/16488 (26 Oct 2026)**. Three entries have been removed from the ISIL (Da'esh) & Al-Qaida Sanctions List, so the assets freeze, travel ban and arms embargo no longer apply to them. The circular refers back to **Chapter IX of the KYC Directions, 2025**.
- [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=13747&Mode=0)

### 2. [CIRCULAR] UAPA s51A: same list, **amendment of 3 entries**
- **Reference:** `RBI/2026-27/302` · `DoR.AML.REC.254/14.06.001/2026-27` · **27 Oct 2026**
- **What it says:** UNSC press release **SC/16490 (26 Oct 2026)** changes identifiers on 3 listed entries, such as aliases and passport details. **These entries are still sanctioned.**
- [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=13748&Mode=0)

### 3. [CONTEXT] SEBI: debenture trustees get until **27 Apr 2027** to ring-fence non-SEBI business
- **Reference:** SEBI circular `HO/(201)2026-DDHS-POD1/I/24467/2026` · **27 Oct 2026**
- **What it says:**
  - Regulation 9C of the DT Regulations (notified 27 Oct 2025) lets DTs move non-SEBI activities into separate business units (SBUs).
  - The deadline had already been extended once, to 27 Oct 2026. It now moves out by six months because SEBI's Expert Working Group (set up in June 2026) is reviewing the whole DT framework, SBUs included.
  - All other provisions of the 25 Nov 2025 circular stay unchanged.
- **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** none directly. The circular applies to debenture trustees, not to issuers such as Muthoot Fincorp.
- [SEBI](https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/oct-2026/extension-of-timeline-for-compliance-with-terms-and-conditions-by-debenture-trustees-dts-for-carrying-out-activities-outside-the-purview-of-sebi_105454.html)

### What is in the market that is *not* an NBFC circular

| Item | What it actually is |
|------|---------------------|
| **RBI/2026-27/300 (26 Oct)**, lead-bank responsibility for re-organised Delhi districts | Addressed to banks only. [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=13746&Mode=0) |
| **RBI press release, 27 Oct:** SGB 2020-21 Series I premature redemption price **₹14,159/g** (simple average of IBJA 999 closes on 23, 26 and 27 Oct) | A price notice. It is not a Direction. [RBI](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63872) |
| **RBI press releases, 27 Oct:** state-finance-secretaries conference, SDL auction results, money-market operations | Institutional and market items. [RBI press releases](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx) |
| **Tata Capital repricing floating loans +20–25 bps from 1 Nov** | Company pricing after the repo hike. Not regulation. [ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/earnings/tata-capital-q2-net-profit-rises-51-on-higher-income/articleshow/135239343.cms) |
| **NBFCs curbing loans in drought districts** | Lender behaviour. Not regulation. [ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/nbfcs-curb-fresh-loans-in-rural-markets-as-weak-monsoon-raises-repayment-risks/articleshow/135222291.cms) |
| **RBI drafts** | Latest still **11 Sep** (KYC). The Interest Rate Directions draft (**12 Aug**) and the revolving-credit draft (**6 Aug**) are still pending. [Drafts](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/DraftNotificationsGuildelines.aspx) |
| **IBBI** | Latest circulars still **24 Sep**. [IBBI circulars](https://ibbi.gov.in/en/legal-framework/circulars) |

Primary sources checked this morning (IST):
- [RBI Notifications](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx): latest block 27 Oct (/301, /302); 26 Oct (/300).
- [RBI Press Releases](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx): latest 27 Oct.
- [RBI Drafts](https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/DraftNotificationsGuildelines.aspx): latest 11 Sep.
- [SEBI circulars](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/home/HomeAction.do?doListing=yes&sid=1&ssid=7&smid=0): latest 27 Oct (DT SBU extension).
- [IBBI circulars](https://ibbi.gov.in/en/legal-framework/circulars): latest 24 Sep.

---

## ⏰ What did *not* move overnight

| Item | Status | Next date |
|------|--------|-----------|
| **Calamity relief, CIMS half-yearly upload** | First half-year since Chapter VI-A went live on 1 Jul. A NIL return is required if no relief was given (paras 122Q–122R). | **30 Oct 2026** (2 days) |
| **Q2 FY27 / LODR 52** | Books frozen at 30 Sep. | **14 Nov 2026** (17 days) |
| **Credit Risk-o-Meter** | Issued 7 Oct; goes live 45 days later. | **21 Nov 2026** (24 days) |
| Revolving-credit draft (6 Aug) | Still a draft. The RBI calls it a clarification. Bajaj is introducing term-loan variants from 1 Nov. | Final expected around Nov 2026 |
| Interest Rate Directions draft (12 Aug) | Comments closed 11 Sep. | **1 Apr 2027** if finalised |
| Recovery agents (RBC 3rd Amendment) | Certification, calling window, call recording. | **1 Jan 2027** (65 days) |
| Type I deregistration / NBFC-AA interoperability | Window open. | **31 Dec 2026** (64 days) |
| Repo | **5.50%** (unchanged since the October MPC). The Fed decides tonight IST. | Next MPC |

---

## 📅 Regulatory calendar

- **30 Oct 2026:** half-yearly CIMS upload on calamity relief (a NIL return is required if no relief was given).
- **14 Nov 2026:** last date for Q2 FY27 results of listed debt issuers under SEBI LODR Regulation 52.
- **21 Nov 2026:** SEBI Credit Risk-o-Meter disclosure applies to new debt offer documents.
- **31 Dec 2026:** Type I NBFC deregistration / NBFC-AA interoperability window closes.
- **1 Jan 2027:** recovery-agent requirements under the RBC Third Amendment take effect.
- **1 Apr 2027:** Interest Rate Directions take effect, if finalised.
- **27 Apr 2027:** debenture trustees' deadline to ring-fence non-SEBI business.
- **30 Sep 2027:** last date to reverse unrealised pre-SNFA interest on legacy SNFA stock.

cards.title: Gold sits about 20% below its January record, and analysts have started putting peer LTVs side by side. The SGB redemption price RBI set for today says the…
cards.summary: BusinessToday (27 Oct) says gold is roughly 20% below its record of ₹1,76,306/10g set on 29 Jan, and it opened Tuesday at ₹1,40,664 . Equirus's Shreepal Doshi lists LTVs of Muthoot Finance 64% (Q1), Manappuram 65.6% , Fedbank 68% (Q2), IIFL 70% (Q2) and Capri Global 73.35% (Q1), calling Capri's position "less comfortable".
cards.impact: Muthoot Fincorp is not on the Equirus list, so its portfolio LTV is not part of this comparison. As an illustration of the arithmetic, a loan written at 75% LTV at the January peak would now be at about 94% of current gold value (75 ÷ 0.80).

cards.title: NBFCs are pulling back from drought-hit rural districts. The south is the worst-hit region.
cards.summary: Shriram, M&M Finance and Bajaj Finance are curbing fresh loans in districts hit by the weak monsoon. The season ended 13% below normal , the weakest since 2015.
cards.impact: Muthoot Fincorp is Kerala-based with a large southern network, and its subsidiary Muthoot Microfin also lends in the south, the region with the largest rainfall deficit. If large lenders pull back from drought districts, lenders that stay may see both more demand and more risk.

cards.summary: Q2 FY27 PAT was ₹1,660 cr (₹1,097 cr a year ago). AUM is ₹3.08 lakh cr (+26%) and NII ₹3,696 cr (+23%) .
cards.impact: Large lenders are repricing their books upward. Muthoot Fincorp's gold loans are largely short-tenor, so pricing on new loans and renewals is the main lever for passing on higher funding costs.
